description: Builds Redfish URIs locally and sends them to remote OOB controllers to get information back.

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Security token for authentication with OOB controller.

parameters.name: baseuri
parameters.description: Base URI of OOB controller. Must include this or ioms.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. Only used if validate_certs=true.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category to execute on OOB controller.

parameters.name: ciphers
parameters.description: TLS/SSL Ciphers to use for the request. When a list is provided, all ciphers are joined in order with :. See the OpenSSL Cipher List Format for more details. The available ciphers is dependent on the Python and OpenSSL/LibreSSL versions.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: List of commands to execute on OOB controller.

parameters.name: ioms
parameters.description: List of IOM FQDNs for the enclosure. Must include this or baseuri.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for authentication with OOB controller.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds for URL requests to OOB controller. Default: 10

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: User for authentication with OOB controller.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, TLS/SSL certificates are not validated. Set this to true to enable certificate checking. Should be used together with ca_path. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Get Simple Update Status with individual IOMs specified
  community.general.wdc_redfish_info:
    category: Update
    command: SimpleUpdateStatus
    ioms:
      - iom1.wdc.com
      - iom2.wdc.com
    username: "{{ username }}"
    password: "{{ password }}"
  register: result

- name: Print fetched information
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ result.redfish_facts.simple_update_status.entries | to_nice_json }}"

- name: Get Simple Update Status with baseuri specified
  community.general.wdc_redfish_info:
    category: Update
    command: SimpleUpdateStatus
    baseuri: "iom1.wdc.com"
    username: "{{ username }}"
    password: "{{ password }}"
  register: result

- name: Print fetched information
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ result.redfish_facts.simple_update_status.entries | to_nice_json }}"

return_values.name: Description
return_values.description: Firmware update status description. Returned: always Sample: "Ready for FW update"

return_values.name: ErrorCode
return_values.description: Numeric error code for firmware update status. Non-zero indicates an error condition. Returned: always Sample: 0

return_values.name: EstimatedRemainingMinutes
return_values.description: Estimated number of minutes remaining in firmware update operation. Returned: always Sample: 20

return_values.name: StatusCode
return_values.description: Firmware update status code. Returned: always Sample: 2
